body: Warehouse format, no gimmick. Full bar: Miller High Life cans $5, CARTEL Coffee (Mountain Man cold brew + whiskey) $9. Sound system is first capex. 21+ always. No VIP. 150 nights/yr, $1.5M-$3M gross target. Store 0 is 2 blocks away; tortilla truck goes late Thu-Sat.
